bear_assumptions: USD 0.55 normalized diluted EPS at 15x as take-rate compression, merchant concentration, regulatory costs and weak cash conversion impair growth; settlement cash is excluded from corporate liquidity.
base_assumptions: USD 0.75 normalized diluted EPS at 22x as TPV and gross profit continue growing, second-half operating leverage improves, corporate cash remains resilient and employee-plan dilution stays contained.
bull_assumptions: USD 0.90 normalized diluted EPS at 28x as geographic and product expansion sustain growth, cash conversion normalizes, operating leverage and capital returns outperform, and no material regulatory setback occurs.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh mark restores the required base upside, bear/base payoff and margin of safety while gross-profit growth, cash conversion and operating leverage remain supported; downgrade on persistent take-rate compression, loss or repricing of major merchants, weak cash conversion, material tax or regulatory sanctions, settlement-liquidity restrictions, adverse litigation, or dilution that offsets business growth.
